gloss: to turn around; to look back

definitions.gloss: to turn around; to turn one's head
definitions.explanation: To physically turn to face another direction, especially behind oneself.

definitions.gloss: to pay attention to; to take notice of
definitions.explanation: To show interest in someone or something, often used in the negative.

examples.japanese: {誰|だれ}かが{振|ふ}り{向|む}いた。
{後|うし}ろから{声|こえ}をかけられて{振|ふ}り{向|む}いた。
examples.english: Someone called out from behind me and I turned around.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{振|ふ}り{向|む}きもせずに{歩|ある}いて{行|い}った。
examples.english: She walked away without even looking back.

examples.japanese: {急|きゅう}に{肩|かた}をたたかれて{振|ふ}り{向|む}くと、{友人|ゆうじん}が{立|た}っていた。
examples.english: When I was suddenly tapped on the shoulder and turned around, my friend was standing there.

examples.japanese: {道|みち}を{歩|ある}いていたら{後|うし}ろから{名前|なまえ}を{呼|よ}ばれたので{振|ふ}り{向|む}くと、{昔|むかし}の{同級生|どうきゅうせい}だった。
examples.english: While walking down the street, I heard my name called from behind, and when I turned around, it was an old classmate.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{振|ふ}り{向|む}いてくれない。
examples.english: He won't pay attention to me.

examples.japanese: いくらアピールしても、{彼|かれ}は{振|ふ}り{向|む}いてくれない。
examples.english: No matter how much I try to get his attention, he won't give me a second glance.

examples.japanese: {誰|だれ}も{振|ふ}り{向|む}かないような{地味|じみ}な{存在|そんざい}だった。
examples.english: I was such a plain presence that nobody took notice of me.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{美|うつく}しくて、{道|みち}を{歩|ある}くと{誰|だれ}もが{振|ふ}り{向|む}く。
examples.english: She is so beautiful that everyone turns to look at her when she walks down the street.

examples.japanese: {何年|なんねん}も{片思|かたおも}いをしていたが、{彼|かれ}は{一度|いちど}も{振|ふ}り{向|む}いてくれなかった。
examples.english: I had a one-sided crush for years, but he never once showed any interest in me.

notes:
{振|ふ}り{向|む}く is an intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}) formed from {振|ふ}る (to swing) + {向|む}く (to face). It primarily describes the physical action of turning around.

ASPECT (ている):
{振|ふ}り{向|む}いている indicates someone has turned around and is facing that direction.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [direction]を{振|ふ}り{向|む}く — to turn toward [direction]
- [person]が{振|ふ}り{向|む}く — [person] turns around

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {後|うし}ろを{振|ふ}り{向|む}く (turn to look behind)
- {振|ふ}り{向|む}きもしない (doesn't even turn around; ignores completely)
- {振|ふ}り{向|む}いてくれない (won't pay attention to me)

IDIOMATIC USAGE:
{振|ふ}り{向|む}いてくれない in romantic contexts means someone won't show interest or return one's feelings.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る: to look back (physical + figurative reflection)
- {振|ふ}り{向|む}く: only physical turning
